pillars.note: No direct fire-safety pillar. The requirements document says FLEX is focused on spacecraft (the words 'fire safety and fire suppression' are on the next printed line, whose ligatures prevent a 1:1 quote) while FLEX-2 returns to the broader objective of improving the fundamental understanding of liquid-fuel combustion (the sentence wraps over the quoted lines, p. 7). The PSI record nevertheless tags the SubResearch Area 'Spacecraft Fire Safety': the two sources differ, not reconciled. Its objective 3 is flame extinction mechanisms and boundaries (ISA), which is context for suppression research, not a suppressant-effectiveness study. Pillar list left empty on purpose; the reviewer should decide.
